published.description: online when the device connects. offline when it shuts down cleanly or when the broker loses it (last will).
Air probe, one decimal. nan when the probe does not answer.
HC-SR04 median over 0.5 s (last 10 raw reads). Trig GPIO26, echo GPIO27. nan when the echo does not arrive.
Received signal strength of the Wi-Fi connection.
Seconds since boot. Drops back after a reboot or an OTA update.
MC-38 reed on GPIO33 with the internal pull-up, other wire on GND. ON when the contact is open (door open). OFF when the magnet closes the contact (door shut).

Derived from door_distance, not a separate switch. ON after the distance stays above the closed baseline plus 0.05 m for 2 seconds, or the echo is missing. OFF 1 second after it returns. Published only once the closed distance is above 0.
ON after the air stays above number/alarm_threshold for 10 minutes. OFF 1 minute after it returns to the threshold or below. Published only when it changes. Does not drive the buzzer in this variant.
Broker address in use. Stored in flash.
Air probe polling interval, 1 to 300. Stored in flash.
Calibrated distance of the closed door. Stored in flash. 0 means not calibrated.
Air temperature above which the local alarm can turn on. Stored in flash. Default 5.0. Range -40 to 40 in steps of 0.1.

Device log lines at the firmware log level, with ANSI colors. When the DS18B20 checksum fails it carries a warning like `Scratch pad: 50.05.4B.46.7F.FF.0C.10.1C (1C)`: the 9 bytes the probe sent, then the CRC the device computed from the first 8. The server lists these under Debug da sonda.

commands.description: Changes the broker address and reconnects. Stored in flash.
Changes the air probe polling interval in seconds, 1 to 300. Stored in flash.
Sets the closed-door distance in meters, 0 to 4. Stored in flash. 0 clears the calibration.
Sets the air alarm threshold in °C, -40 to 40 in steps of 0.1. Stored in flash.
Measures the closed door for 3 seconds and stores the median when at least 5 valid samples arrive.

outside_prefix.description: Published by ESPHome on every connection, retained. JSON with the device IP addresses, MAC, ESPHome version and board. Not checked by the server.
